LIMITER / KEY INSIGHT: capacity (vn_n_filters^) AND data (train_n^) were BOTH falsified at the OLD noisy OVER-UNROLLED vn_T=5 regime and have NEVER been tested at the now-working shallow vn_T=2 depth -- the iter-8 falsifier explicitly flagged this as the next move. CHOICE OF KNOB (capacity over data, from NUMBERS): at vn_T=5 vn_n_filters 16->24 REGRESSED -0.0133 (iter-2) while train_n 200->480 gave only +0.0036 (iter-5, near-saturated at 480/579). At vn_T=5 the learned regulariser was a BLUNT over-smoother re-injected 5x via the in-loop projector DC step, so MORE filters made the smoother WORSE; at the clean vn_T=2 denoiser-dominant regime the recon is no longer smoother-bound, so a richer 24-filter bank has headroom to express an EDGE-PRESERVING regulariser instead of collapsing to smoothing. train_n is already near data-saturation (480/579, +0.0036 at full) so capacity is the higher-value re-probe. KEEP train_n=480. MECHANISM: vn_n_filters 16->24 (the solver default capacity) gives the learned filter bank K_i more degrees of freedom; at the working shallow depth where the denoiser shows through, the extra filters can preserve structure/contrast rather than the DC-smoothing they collapsed to at vn_T=5. HYPOTHESIS: with 24 filters at the working vn_T=2 depth, val_ssim rises above the iter-7 BEST 0.86068 and hr clears 0.154039 (the capacity lever falsified-at-vn_T=5 now helps at the shallow depth). FALSIFIER (numeric): if val_ssim <= 0.86068 / hr <= 0.154039 at vn_T=2 with 24 filters, capacity does NOT transfer to the shallow regime either -- 16 filters is the optimum at all depths -- and iter-10 should re-probe the LAST untested data lever (train_n 480->579, full pool) at vn_T=2. BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_n_filters 16->24 = ~1.4x per-step RBF/conv cost; iter-7 ran 971.2s total at N_k=16/vn_T=2/train_n=480, so max_train_s=1000 still BINDS the train wall (fewer epochs fit but still past the ep3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison; cf. iter-2 ran N_k=24 fine at 1351s). val_n=214 kept. Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~160 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1160s, under the 1800s SLURM kill (>600s margin). MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=2 x N_k=24 with batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true stays within the 16 GB RTX5000 (iter-2/3/4 all ran N_k=24 at vn_T=5 with no OOM; vn_T=2 is a LIGHTER footprint -- fewer unrolled steps -> less activation memory; far from the hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).
